templates.name: validate-record
templates.label: Validate record
templates.description: Check a record against a field ruleset; pass valid records, collect reasons for invalid ones.
preconditions: A record object is available on the `record` input
A field ruleset (required / type / range) is defined
postconditions: `valid` is true only when every rule passes
`errors` lists a human-readable reason per failed rule

steps.label: Load the ruleset
steps.detail: Read the per-field rules from the `rules` input (required, type, min/max, pattern).

steps.label: Evaluate each field
steps.detail: For every rule, read record[field] and test it; push a message to errors on failure.

steps.label: Decide
steps.detail: valid = errors.length === 0; return both so downstream can branch.

rules.description: Per-field rules: { field: { required?, type?, min?, max?, pattern? } }

templates.name: route-by-rule
templates.label: Route by rule (decision table)
templates.description: Pick a branch label by evaluating an ordered decision table against the input — first match wins.
preconditions: An input object is available on `item`
An ordered list of rules (condition → route) is defined
postconditions: `route` is the label of the first matching rule, or the default

steps.label: Read the decision table
steps.detail: Each rule is { when: {field, op, value}, route }; evaluate top to bottom.

steps.label: Find first match
steps.detail: Return the route of the first rule whose condition holds for `item`.

steps.label: Fall back
steps.detail: If no rule matches, return the configured default route and matched=false.

templates.name: approve-reject
templates.label: Approve / reject (four-eyes)
templates.description: Gate an item on a policy plus an explicit human decision, recording who decided and why.
preconditions: An item under review is on `item`
A decision (`approve` | `reject`) and reviewer identity are supplied
postconditions: `approved` reflects the reviewer decision after policy checks
An audit trail (reviewer, reason, timestamp) is attached

steps.label: Apply policy pre-checks
steps.detail: Run automatic guards first; auto-reject anything that fails policy regardless of the human input.

steps.label: Record the human decision
steps.detail: Capture decision, reviewer, and reason for the audit trail.

steps.label: Emit outcome
steps.detail: approved = policyPassed && decision === 'approve'; include the decision record.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identity for the audit trail

templates.name: dedupe
templates.label: Deduplicate rows
templates.description: Collapse rows that share a key, keeping a chosen survivor and counting duplicates removed.
preconditions: A list of rows is available on `rows`
A dedupe key (one or more fields) is configured
postconditions: `rows` contains at most one survivor per key
`removed` counts how many duplicates were dropped

steps.label: Build the key
steps.detail: Compute a composite key per row from the configured key fields.

steps.label: Pick a survivor
steps.detail: For each key keep the first (or newest by `tiebreak`) row; drop the rest.

steps.label: Report
steps.detail: Return the deduped rows and the count removed.

tiebreak.description: Field to keep the max of when keys collide

templates.name: enrich-lookup
templates.label: Enrich via lookup
templates.description: Join each row with a reference table on a key, merging the matched reference fields in.
preconditions: A reference dataset/table and the join key are available
postconditions: Each row gains the reference fields when a match is found
`unmatched` counts rows with no reference match

steps.label: Index the reference
steps.detail: Build a map from join key to reference row for O(1) lookups.

steps.label: Merge
steps.detail: For each input row, look up by key and spread the reference fields in (input wins on conflicts).

steps.label: Track misses
steps.detail: Count rows with no match so quality can be monitored.

templates.name: threshold-flag
templates.label: Threshold flag
templates.description: Score each item and flag those crossing a configurable threshold for review.
preconditions: A numeric field and threshold are configured
postconditions: `flagged` lists the items that cross the threshold

steps.label: Read the metric
steps.detail: Extract the numeric field from each item.

steps.label: Compare
steps.detail: Flag items where value >= threshold (or <= for lower bounds).

steps.label: Collect
steps.detail: Return the flagged subset and its count.

templates.name: map-transform
templates.label: Map / transform
templates.description: Reshape each row to a target schema via a field mapping, dropping or renaming as configured.
preconditions: A field mapping (source → target) is configured
postconditions: Each output row has only the mapped target fields

steps.label: Read the mapping
steps.detail: mapping is { targetField: sourceField }.

steps.label: Project each row
steps.detail: Build a new object per row using the mapping; skip unmapped fields.

steps.label: Return
steps.detail: Emit the transformed rows in the original order.

templates.name: aggregate
templates.label: Aggregate / group-by
templates.description: Group rows by a key and compute aggregates (count / sum / avg) per group.
preconditions: A group key and the measures to aggregate are configured
postconditions: `groups` holds one summary row per distinct key
Each summary carries the requested aggregates

steps.label: Bucket
steps.detail: Group rows by the configured group_by field.

steps.label: Reduce
steps.detail: Per group compute count and the sum/avg of each measure field.

steps.label: Emit
steps.detail: Return one row per group with the aggregates.
